description: Search for assets in the Picsha AI platform using vector or standard keyword search. Note: Results cover every asset the configured API key can reach: the whole organization for an organization key, or the owner's own assets for a personal key. Setting PICSHA_EXTERNAL_USER_ID does not narrow them to one user.

mode.description: Search mode. 'ai' uses vector hybrid search, 'standard' uses exact keyword / tag matching.

query.description: The search query string. You can append natural language dates/actions like 'added today' or 'uploaded last week' to filter by time.

threshold.description: Confidence threshold for AI searches (0.0 to 1.0)

name: search_assets
